1	#!/system/bin/sh
2	# ============================================================
3	# HyperOS 充电优化模块 - 撞墙探测算法 V4.1
4	# ============================================================
5	# 核心思想：通过撞墙探测系统极限，每次撞墙后降低功率继续探测，
6	#          最终找到"刚好不撞墙"的最大恒定功率。
7	#
8	# 四个模式：fast(48°C) / fast_cooler(48°C) / balance(46°C) / cool(42°C)
9	# 状态机：init → probing → cooling → stabilizing
10	#
11	# 关键机制：
12	#   1. 撞墙探测：从最高功率开始，撞墙后满限流冷却，降低功率继续探测
13	#   2. 温度裕度探测：温度远低于目标时主动提高功率
14	#   3. 保守档位：撞墙后更新保守档位，环境变差时回退
15	#
16	# 学习文件：/data/adb/modules/hyperos_charge_optimization/*_learn.conf
17	# 详细说明：见桌面「充电优化撞墙探测算法说明.md」
18	# ============================================================
19	
20	MODTAG="HyperOSChargeV20260730"
21	MODDIR="/data/adb/modules/hyperos_charge_optimization"
22	PS_DIR="/sys/class/power_supply"
23	STATE_FILE="$MODDIR/orig_state"
24	MODE_FILE="$MODDIR/charge_mode"
25	
26	mylog(){ log -t "$MODTAG" "$1"; }
27	
28	# 等待开机完成
29	while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != "1" ]; do
30	  sleep 1
31	done
32	
33	# 数字校验
34	is_num(){
35	  case "$1" in
36	    ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
37	    *) return 0 ;;
38	  esac
39	}
40	
41	# 数值钳制
42	clamp(){
43	  v="$1"; min="$2"; max="$3"
44	  [ "$v" -lt "$min" ] && v="$min"
45	  [ "$v" -gt "$max" ] && v="$max"
46	  echo "$v"
47	}
48	
49	# 电池节点路径
50	BATT="$PS_DIR/battery"
51	STATUS_NODE="$BATT/status"
52	USB_ONLINE="$PS_DIR/usb/online"
53	WIRELESS_ONLINE="$PS_DIR/wireless/online"
54	
55	get_soc(){ cat "$BATT/capacity" 2>/dev/null; }
56	get_temp(){ cat "$BATT/temp" 2>/dev/null; }
57	
58	# 功率计算：单位为"分瓦"(W*10)
59	# 优先用 current_now * voltage_now 现算，power_now 兜底
60	get_power_dw(){
61	  CN=$(cat "$BATT/current_now" 2>/dev/null)
62	  VN=$(cat "$BATT/voltage_now" 2>/dev/null)
63	  case "$CN" in -*) CN=${CN#-} ;; esac
64	  case "$VN" in -*) VN=${VN#-} ;; esac
65	  if is_num "$CN" && is_num "$VN"; then
66	    IMA=$((CN/1000))
67	    VMV=$((VN/1000))
68	    echo $(( (IMA*VMV) / 100000 ))
69	    return
70	  fi
71	  PN=$(cat "$BATT/power_now" 2>/dev/null)
72	  case "$PN" in -*) PN=${PN#-} ;; esac
73	  if is_num "$PN"; then
74	    echo $((PN/100000))
75	    return
76	  fi
77	  echo 0
78	}
79	
80	# 充电状态检测
81	is_charging(){
82	  ST=""
83	  [ -f "$STATUS_NODE" ] && ST=$(cat "$STATUS_NODE" 2>/dev/null)
84	  case "$ST" in
85	    Charging|Full) return 0 ;;
86	  esac
87	  [ -f "$USB_ONLINE" ] && [ "$(cat "$USB_ONLINE" 2>/dev/null)" = "1" ] && return 0
88	  [ -f "$WIRELESS_ONLINE" ] && [ "$(cat "$WIRELESS_ONLINE" 2>/dev/null)" = "1" ] && return 0
89	  return 1
90	}
91	
92	# 查找电池冷却设备节点
93	find_battery_cdev(){
94	  for d in /sys/class/thermal/cooling_device*; do
95	    [ -f "$d/type" ] || continue
96	    t=$(cat "$d/type" 2>/dev/null)
97	    if [ "$t" = "battery" ]; then
98	      echo "$d"
99	      return
100	    fi
101	  done
102	}
103	
104	CDEV=$(find_battery_cdev)
105	if [ -z "$CDEV" ]; then
106	  mylog "FATAL: no battery cooling-device found, module disabled on this device"
107	  mkdir -p "$MODDIR/webroot" 2>/dev/null
108	  echo '{"error":"no_battery_cdev","charging":false}' > "$MODDIR/webroot/status.json" 2>/dev/null
109	  exit 0

111

113	is_num "$MAXSTATE" || MAXSTATE=16
114	
115	set_cdev_state(){ echo "$1" > "$CDEV/cur_state" 2>/dev/null; }
116	get_cdev_state(){ cat "$CDEV/cur_state" 2>/dev/null; }
117	get_mode(){ [ -f "$MODE_FILE" ] && cat "$MODE_FILE" || echo balance; }

121	STATUS_JSON="$WEBROOT/status.json"
122	HIST_FILE="$WEBROOT/history.csv"

143	  ccc=$(cat "$BATT/constant_charge_current" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$ccc" || ccc=0
144	  icl=$(cat "$BATT/input_current_limit" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$icl" || icl=0
145	
146	  local ccl ccl_max

148	  ccl_max=$(cat "$BATT/charge_control_limit_max" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$ccl_max" || ccl_max=0
149

152	  usb_cl=$(cat "$PS_DIR/usb/input_current_limit" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$usb_cl" || usb_cl=0
153

156	  qct=$(cat "$PS_DIR/qcom-battery/quick_charge_type" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$qct" || qct=0

158	  [ ! -f "$CHARGE_PROBE_FILE" ] && \
159	    echo "ts,cdev_state,soc,temp,current_now_uA,voltage_now_uV,power_dw,constant_charge_current_max_uA,constant_charge_current_uA,input_current_limit_uA,charge_control_limit,charge_control_limit_max,usb_current_max_uA,usb_input_current_limit_uA,pmic_ibat_mA,quick_charge_type" \

644	                FAST_BEST_SECS=$FAST_STABLE_SECS; FAST_BEST_STATE=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
645	                PW=$(get_power_dw); is_num "$PW" || PW=0; FAST_BEST_POWER=$PW
646	                mylog "FAST NEW BEST: state=$FAST_PROBE_STATE power=${PW}dw dur=${FAST_STABLE_SECS}s"
647	              fi

649	
650	            elif [ "$TEMP" -lt $((FAST_TEMP_RED - MARGIN_THRESHOLD)) ]; then
651	              # 温度裕度足够，尝试提高功率
652	              FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=$((FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS + 2)); FAST_STABLE_SECS=0

656	              fi

658	              FAST_STABLE_SECS=0; FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
659	            fi
660	            RAW_TARGET=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
661	          fi
662	          ;;
663	
664	        "cooling")
665	          # 冷却：等待温度回落，降低功率继续探测
666	          if [ "$TEMP" -le "$FAST_TEMP_SAFE" ]; then
667	            # 关键：HIT_STATE + 2 = 增加state = 降低功率
668	            PROBE_FROM=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
669	            [ "$PROBE_FROM" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && PROBE_FROM=$MAXSTATE
670	            [ "$FAST_SAFE_STATE" -gt "$PROBE_FROM" ] && PROBE_FROM=$FAST_SAFE_STATE
671	
672	            FAST_PROBE_STATE=$PROBE_FROM
673	            FAST_PROBE_PHASE="probing"; FAST_STABLE_SECS=0; FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
674	            RAW_TARGET=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
675	            mylog "FAST COOL DONE: 降低功率到 state=$FAST_PROBE_STATE 继续探测"
676	          else
677	            RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE
678	          fi
679	          ;;
680	
681	        "stabilizing")
682	          # 稳定：维持最优档位，撞墙则重新探测
683	          RAW_TARGET=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
684	          if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$FAST_TEMP_RED" ]; then

687	            SAFE_CANDIDATE=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
688	            [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && SAFE_CANDIDATE=$MAXSTATE

691	          fi
692	          ;;
693	      esac
694	    fi
695	
696	  else
697	    RAW_TARGET=0
698	  fi
699	
700	  RAW_TARGET=$(clamp "$RAW_TARGET" 0 "$MAXSTATE")
701	
702	  # 高电量taper：作为下限(floor)，带5%滞回
703	  NEW_SOC_FLOOR=$CUR_SOC_FLOOR
704	  [ "$SOC" -ge 96 ] && [ "$CUR_SOC_FLOOR" -lt $(( (MAXSTATE * 2 + 5) / 10 )) ] && NEW_SOC_FLOOR=$(( (MAXSTATE * 2 + 5) / 10 ))
705	  [ "$SOC" -ge 88 ] && [ "$CUR_SOC_FLOOR" -lt $(( (MAXSTATE * 1 + 5) / 10 )) ] && NEW_SOC_FLOOR=$(( (MAXSTATE * 1 + 5) / 10 ))
706	  [ "$SOC" -lt 91 ] && [ "$CUR_SOC_FLOOR" -ge $(( (MAXSTATE * 2 + 5) / 10 )) ] && NEW_SOC_FLOOR=$(( (MAXSTATE * 1 + 5) / 10 ))

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================================
# HyperOS 充电优化模块 - 撞墙探测算法 V4.1
# ============================================================
# 核心思想：通过撞墙探测系统极限，每次撞墙后降低功率继续探测，
#          最终找到"刚好不撞墙"的最大恒定功率。
#
# 四个模式：fast(48°C) / fast_cooler(48°C) / balance(46°C) / cool(42°C)
# 状态机：init → probing → cooling → stabilizing
#
# 关键机制：
#   1. 撞墙探测：从最高功率开始，撞墙后满限流冷却，降低功率继续探测
#   2. 温度裕度探测：温度远低于目标时主动提高功率
#   3. 保守档位：撞墙后更新保守档位，环境变差时回退
#
# 学习文件：/data/adb/modules/hyperos_charge_optimization/*_learn.conf
# 详细说明：见桌面「充电优化撞墙探测算法说明.md」
# ============================================================

MODTAG="HyperOSChargeV20260730"
MODDIR="/data/adb/modules/hyperos_charge_optimization"
PS_DIR="/sys/class/power_supply"
STATE_FILE="$MODDIR/orig_state"
MODE_FILE="$MODDIR/charge_mode"

mylog(){ log -t "$MODTAG" "$1"; }

# 等待开机完成
while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != "1" ]; do
  sleep 1
done

# 数字校验
is_num(){
  case "$1" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    *) return 0 ;;
  esac
}

# 数值钳制
clamp(){
  v="$1"; min="$2"; max="$3"
  [ "$v" -lt "$min" ] && v="$min"
  [ "$v" -gt "$max" ] && v="$max"
  echo "$v"
}

# 电池节点路径
BATT="$PS_DIR/battery"
STATUS_NODE="$BATT/status"
USB_ONLINE="$PS_DIR/usb/online"
WIRELESS_ONLINE="$PS_DIR/wireless/online"

get_soc(){ cat "$BATT/capacity" 2>/dev/null; }
get_temp(){ cat "$BATT/temp" 2>/dev/null; }

# 功率计算：单位为"分瓦"(W*10)
# 优先用 current_now * voltage_now 现算，power_now 兜底
get_power_dw(){
  CN=$(cat "$BATT/current_now" 2>/dev/null)
  VN=$(cat "$BATT/voltage_now" 2>/dev/null)
  case "$CN" in -*) CN=${CN#-} ;; esac
  case "$VN" in -*) VN=${VN#-} ;; esac
  if is_num "$CN" && is_num "$VN"; then
    IMA=$((CN/1000))
    VMV=$((VN/1000))
    echo $(( (IMA*VMV) / 100000 ))
    return
  fi
  PN=$(cat "$BATT/power_now" 2>/dev/null)
  case "$PN" in -*) PN=${PN#-} ;; esac
  if is_num "$PN"; then
    echo $((PN/100000))
    return
  fi
  echo 0
}

# 充电状态检测
is_charging(){
  ST=""
  [ -f "$STATUS_NODE" ] && ST=$(cat "$STATUS_NODE" 2>/dev/null)
  case "$ST" in
    Charging|Full) return 0 ;;
  esac
  [ -f "$USB_ONLINE" ] && [ "$(cat "$USB_ONLINE" 2>/dev/null)" = "1" ] && return 0
  [ -f "$WIRELESS_ONLINE" ] && [ "$(cat "$WIRELESS_ONLINE" 2>/dev/null)" = "1" ] && return 0
  return 1
}

# 查找电池冷却设备节点
find_battery_cdev(){
  for d in /sys/class/thermal/cooling_device*; do
    [ -f "$d/type" ] || continue
    t=$(cat "$d/type" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$t" = "battery" ]; then
      echo "$d"
      return
    fi
  done
}

CDEV=$(find_battery_cdev)
if [ -z "$CDEV" ]; then
  mylog "FATAL: no battery cooling-device found, module disabled on this device"
  mkdir -p "$MODDIR/webroot" 2>/dev/null
  echo '{"error":"no_battery_cdev","charging":false}' > "$MODDIR/webroot/status.json" 2>/dev/null
  exit 0
fi

MAXSTATE=$(cat "$CDEV/max_state" 2>/dev/null)
is_num "$MAXSTATE" || MAXSTATE=16

set_cdev_state(){ echo "$1" > "$CDEV/cur_state" 2>/dev/null; }
get_cdev_state(){ cat "$CDEV/cur_state" 2>/dev/null; }
get_mode(){ [ -f "$MODE_FILE" ] && cat "$MODE_FILE" || echo balance; }

# WebUI 和历史记录
WEBROOT="$MODDIR/webroot"
STATUS_JSON="$WEBROOT/status.json"
HIST_FILE="$WEBROOT/history.csv"
HIST_INTERVAL=10

# 充电电流探测：记录 cooling device 档位与实际电流的映射
CHARGE_PROBE_FILE="$MODDIR/charge_probe.csv"
PROBE_INTERVAL=30
LAST_PROBE_TS=0

probe_charge_currents(){
  NOW=$(date +%s)
  DIFF=$((NOW - LAST_PROBE_TS))
  [ "$DIFF" -lt "$PROBE_INTERVAL" ] && return
  LAST_PROBE_TS=$NOW

  local cn vn pw
  cn=$(cat "$BATT/current_now" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$cn" || cn=0
  vn=$(cat "$BATT/voltage_now" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$vn" || vn=0
  pw=$(get_power_dw); is_num "$pw" || pw=0

  local cccm ccc icl
  cccm=$(cat "$BATT/constant_charge_current_max" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$cccm" || cccm=0
  ccc=$(cat "$BATT/constant_charge_current" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$ccc" || ccc=0
  icl=$(cat "$BATT/input_current_limit" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$icl" || icl=0

  local ccl ccl_max
  ccl=$(cat "$BATT/charge_control_limit" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$ccl" || ccl=0
  ccl_max=$(cat "$BATT/charge_control_limit_max" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$ccl_max" || ccl_max=0

  local usb_cm usb_cl
  usb_cm=$(cat "$PS_DIR/usb/current_max" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$usb_cm" || usb_cm=0
  usb_cl=$(cat "$PS_DIR/usb/input_current_limit" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$usb_cl" || usb_cl=0

  local pmic_ibat qct
  pmic_ibat=$(cat "$PS_DIR/qcom-battery/pmic_ibat" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$pmic_ibat" || pmic_ibat=0
  qct=$(cat "$PS_DIR/qcom-battery/quick_charge_type" 2>/dev/null); is_num "$qct" || qct=0

  [ ! -f "$CHARGE_PROBE_FILE" ] && \
    echo "ts,cdev_state,soc,temp,current_now_uA,voltage_now_uV,power_dw,constant_charge_current_max_uA,constant_charge_current_uA,input_current_limit_uA,charge_control_limit,charge_control_limit_max,usb_current_max_uA,usb_input_current_limit_uA,pmic_ibat_mA,quick_charge_type" \
    > "$CHARGE_PROBE_FILE"

  echo "${NOW},${CUR_STATE},${SOC},${TEMP},${cn},${vn},${pw},${cccm},${ccc},${icl},${ccl},${ccl_max},${usb_cm},${usb_cl},${pmic_ibat},${qct}" \
    >> "$CHARGE_PROBE_FILE"

  local lines
  lines=$(wc -l < "$CHARGE_PROBE_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
  is_num "$lines" || lines=0
  [ "$lines" -gt 500 ] && tail -n 500 "$CHARGE_PROBE_FILE" > "$CHARGE_PROBE_FILE.tmp" 2>/dev/null && \
    mv "$CHARGE_PROBE_FILE.tmp" "$CHARGE_PROBE_FILE" 2>/dev/null
}

MAX_HIST_LINES=1440  # 1440条*10s=4小时
LAST_HIST_TS=0
mkdir -p "$WEBROOT" 2>/dev/null

# 写入状态JSON供WebUI读取
write_status(){
  cat > "$STATUS_JSON" 2>/dev/null <<EOF
{"charging":$1,"mode":"$2","soc":$3,"temp":$4,"temp_tier":$5,"soc_tier":$6,"final_tier":$7,"state":$8,"maxstate":$9,"power_dw":${10},"ts":$(date +%s)}
EOF
}

# 记录历史数据
record_history(){
  NOW=$(date +%s)
  is_num "$NOW" || return
  DIFF=$((NOW - LAST_HIST_TS))
  [ "$DIFF" -lt "$HIST_INTERVAL" ] && return
  LAST_HIST_TS=$NOW
  echo "$NOW,$1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7" >> "$HIST_FILE" 2>/dev/null
  LINES=$(wc -l < "$HIST_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
  is_num "$LINES" || LINES=0
  [ "$LINES" -gt "$MAX_HIST_LINES" ] && tail -n "$MAX_HIST_LINES" "$HIST_FILE" > "$HIST_FILE.tmp" 2>/dev/null && mv "$HIST_FILE.tmp" "$HIST_FILE" 2>/dev/null
}

# ============================================================
# 撞墙探测算法参数
# ============================================================

# 学习文件路径
FAST_LEARN_FILE="$MODDIR/fast_learn.conf"
FAST_COOLER_LEARN_FILE="$MODDIR/fast_cooler_learn.conf"
BAL_LEARN_FILE="$MODDIR/balance_learn.conf"
COOL_LEARN_FILE="$MODDIR/cool_learn.conf"

# 温度参数（单位：0.1°C，如 460 = 46.0°C）
FAST_TEMP_RED=480        # 快充温度墙 48°C
FAST_TEMP_SAFE=470       # 快充安全温度 47°C
BAL_TEMP_TARGET=460      # 均衡温度墙 46°C
BAL_TEMP_SAFE=450        # 均衡安全温度 45°C
COOL_TEMP_TARGET=420     # 冷却温度墙 42°C
COOL_TEMP_SAFE=410       # 冷却安全温度 41°C

# 探测参数
STABLE_THRESHOLD=150     # 稳定阈值：150轮(~300秒=5分钟)
CRIT_TEMP=485            # 硬保护温度 48.5°C
MARGIN_THRESHOLD=20      # 温度裕度阈值 2°C
MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=60    # 裕度稳定时间 30秒

# 学习数据读写
save_learn(){
  cat > "$1" 2>/dev/null <<EOF
LEARNED_STATE=$2
LEARNED_POWER_DW=$3
LEARNED_DUR=$4
SESSION_COUNT=$5
LEARNED_MAX_POWER_DW=${6:-0}
SAFE_STATE=${7:-$2}
EOF
  mylog "LEARN SAVED: file=$1 state=$2 power=$3 dur=$4 sessions=$5 maxpw=${6:-0} safe=${7:-$2}"
}

load_learn(){
  LEARNED_STATE=0; LEARNED_POWER_DW=0; LEARNED_DUR=0; SESSION_COUNT=0; LEARNED_MAX_POWER_DW=0; SAFE_STATE=0
  if [ -f "$1" ]; then
    . "$1" 2>/dev/null
    is_num "$LEARNED_STATE" || LEARNED_STATE=0
    is_num "$LEARNED_POWER_DW" || LEARNED_POWER_DW=0
    is_num "$LEARNED_DUR" || LEARNED_DUR=0
    is_num "$SESSION_COUNT" || SESSION_COUNT=0
    is_num "$LEARNED_MAX_POWER_DW" || LEARNED_MAX_POWER_DW=0
    is_num "$SAFE_STATE" || SAFE_STATE=$LEARNED_STATE
  fi
}

# 保存原始状态
save_orig_state(){
  [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ] && return
  mkdir -p "$MODDIR" 2>/dev/null
  ORIG_STATE=$(get_cdev_state)
  is_num "$ORIG_STATE" || ORIG_STATE=0
  {
    echo "CDEV=$CDEV"
    echo "ORIG_STATE=$ORIG_STATE"
  } > "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null
}
save_orig_state
. "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null
[ -z "$ORIG_STATE" ] && ORIG_STATE=0

# 加载学习数据
INIT_MODE=$(get_mode)
if [ "$INIT_MODE" = "fast_cooler" ]; then
  load_learn "$FAST_COOLER_LEARN_FILE"
  CUR_FAST_LEARN_FILE="$FAST_COOLER_LEARN_FILE"
elif [ "$INIT_MODE" = "fast" ]; then
  load_learn "$FAST_LEARN_FILE"
  CUR_FAST_LEARN_FILE="$FAST_LEARN_FILE"
fi
FAST_LEARNED_STATE=$LEARNED_STATE
FAST_LEARNED_POWER=$LEARNED_POWER_DW
FAST_LEARNED_DUR=$LEARNED_DUR
FAST_LEARNED_SESSIONS=$SESSION_COUNT
FAST_LEARNED_MAXPW=$LEARNED_MAX_POWER_DW

load_learn "$BAL_LEARN_FILE"
BAL_LEARNED_STATE=$LEARNED_STATE
BAL_LEARNED_POWER=$LEARNED_POWER_DW
BAL_LEARNED_DUR=$LEARNED_DUR
BAL_LEARNED_SESSIONS=$SESSION_COUNT
BAL_SAFE_STATE=$SAFE_STATE

load_learn "$COOL_LEARN_FILE"
COOL_LEARNED_STATE=$LEARNED_STATE
COOL_LEARNED_POWER=$LEARNED_POWER_DW
COOL_LEARNED_DUR=$LEARNED_DUR
COOL_LEARNED_SESSIONS=$SESSION_COUNT
COOL_SAFE_STATE=$SAFE_STATE

mylog "INIT CDEV=$CDEV MAXSTATE=$MAXSTATE ORIG=$ORIG_STATE MODE=$INIT_MODE"
mylog "  BAL: state=$BAL_LEARNED_STATE power=${BAL_LEARNED_POWER}dw safe=$BAL_SAFE_STATE"
mylog "  COOL: state=$COOL_LEARNED_STATE power=${COOL_LEARNED_POWER}dw safe=$COOL_SAFE_STATE"
mylog "  FAST: state=$FAST_LEARNED_STATE power=${FAST_LEARNED_POWER}dw maxpw=${FAST_LEARNED_MAXPW}dw"

# ============================================================
# 探测状态机变量
# ============================================================

RAW_TARGET=0
CUR_STATE=$ORIG_STATE
LOOP_COUNT=0
NOT_CHARGING_STREAK=0
NOT_CHARGING_DEBOUNCE=3
CUR_SOC_FLOOR=0

# 均衡模式
BAL_PROBE_STATE=0; BAL_PROBE_PHASE="init"
BAL_HIT_COUNT=0; BAL_STABLE_SECS=0; BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
BAL_BEST_STATE=$BAL_LEARNED_STATE; BAL_BEST_POWER=$BAL_LEARNED_POWER; BAL_BEST_SECS=$BAL_LEARNED_DUR
BAL_SESSION_SESSED=0

# 冷却模式
COOL_PROBE_STATE=0; COOL_PROBE_PHASE="init"
COOL_HIT_COUNT=0; COOL_STABLE_SECS=0; COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
COOL_BEST_STATE=$COOL_LEARNED_STATE; COOL_BEST_POWER=$COOL_LEARNED_POWER; COOL_BEST_SECS=$COOL_LEARNED_DUR
COOL_SESSION_SESSED=0

# 快充模式
FAST_PROBE_STATE=0; FAST_PROBE_PHASE="init"
FAST_HIT_COUNT=0; FAST_STABLE_SECS=0; FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
FAST_BEST_STATE=$FAST_LEARNED_STATE; FAST_BEST_POWER=$FAST_LEARNED_POWER; FAST_BEST_SECS=$FAST_LEARNED_DUR
FAST_SESSION_SESSED=0; FAST_SESSED=0
FAST_SAFE_STATE=$FAST_LEARNED_STATE
LAST_FAST_SUBMODE=""
FAST_MAX_POWER_DW=${FAST_LEARNED_MAXPW:-0}
FAST_BOOST_ACTIVE=0; FAST_BOOST_RECORDING=0

# ============================================================
# 主循环
# ============================================================

while true; do
  # 未充电状态处理
  if ! is_charging; then
    NOT_CHARGING_STREAK=$((NOT_CHARGING_STREAK+1))
    # 连续确认多次才清零，避免快充协议重协商导致误清
    if [ "$NOT_CHARGING_STREAK" -ge "$NOT_CHARGING_DEBOUNCE" ]; then
      # 保存学习数据（保守档位 = max(当前保守, 最优)）
      if [ "$BAL_SESSION_SESSED" = "1" ] && [ "$BAL_BEST_SECS" -gt 0 ]; then
        NEW_SAFE=$BAL_SAFE_STATE
        [ "$BAL_BEST_STATE" -gt "$NEW_SAFE" ] && NEW_SAFE=$BAL_BEST_STATE
        save_learn "$BAL_LEARN_FILE" "$BAL_BEST_STATE" "$BAL_BEST_POWER" "$BAL_BEST_SECS" "$((BAL_LEARNED_SESSIONS+1))" 0 "$NEW_SAFE"
      fi
      if [ "$COOL_SESSION_SESSED" = "1" ] && [ "$COOL_BEST_SECS" -gt 0 ]; then
        NEW_SAFE=$COOL_SAFE_STATE
        [ "$COOL_BEST_STATE" -gt "$NEW_SAFE" ] && NEW_SAFE=$COOL_BEST_STATE
        save_learn "$COOL_LEARN_FILE" "$COOL_BEST_STATE" "$COOL_BEST_POWER" "$COOL_BEST_SECS" "$((COOL_LEARNED_SESSIONS+1))" 0 "$NEW_SAFE"
      fi
      if [ "$FAST_SESSION_SESSED" = "1" ] && [ "$FAST_BEST_SECS" -gt 0 ]; then
        NEW_SAFE=$FAST_SAFE_STATE
        [ "$FAST_BEST_STATE" -gt "$NEW_SAFE" ] && NEW_SAFE=$FAST_BEST_STATE
        save_learn "$CUR_FAST_LEARN_FILE" "$FAST_BEST_STATE" "$FAST_BEST_POWER" "$FAST_BEST_SECS" "$((FAST_LEARNED_SESSIONS+1))" "$FAST_MAX_POWER_DW" "$NEW_SAFE"
      elif [ "$FAST_MAX_POWER_DW" -gt 0 ]; then
        save_learn "$CUR_FAST_LEARN_FILE" "$FAST_LEARNED_STATE" "$FAST_LEARNED_POWER" "$FAST_LEARNED_DUR" "$FAST_LEARNED_SESSIONS" "$FAST_MAX_POWER_DW" "$FAST_SAFE_STATE"
      fi

      # 重置探测状态（保守档位保留到下次充电）
      RAW_TARGET=0; LOOP_COUNT=0; CUR_SOC_FLOOR=0

      BAL_PROBE_STATE=0; BAL_PROBE_PHASE="init"
      BAL_HIT_COUNT=0; BAL_STABLE_SECS=0; BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
      BAL_BEST_STATE=$BAL_LEARNED_STATE; BAL_BEST_POWER=$BAL_LEARNED_POWER; BAL_BEST_SECS=$BAL_LEARNED_DUR
      BAL_SESSION_SESSED=0

      COOL_PROBE_STATE=0; COOL_PROBE_PHASE="init"
      COOL_HIT_COUNT=0; COOL_STABLE_SECS=0; COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
      COOL_BEST_STATE=$COOL_LEARNED_STATE; COOL_BEST_POWER=$COOL_LEARNED_POWER; COOL_BEST_SECS=$COOL_LEARNED_DUR
      COOL_SESSION_SESSED=0
      COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
      COOL_SAFE_STATE=$COOL_SAFE_STATE  # 保守档位保留

      FAST_PROBE_STATE=0; FAST_PROBE_PHASE="init"
      FAST_HIT_COUNT=0; FAST_STABLE_SECS=0; FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
      FAST_BEST_STATE=$FAST_LEARNED_STATE; FAST_BEST_POWER=$FAST_LEARNED_POWER; FAST_BEST_SECS=$FAST_LEARNED_DUR
      FAST_SESSION_SESSED=0; FAST_SESSED=0
      FAST_SAFE_STATE=$FAST_SAFE_STATE
      LAST_FAST_SUBMODE=""
      FAST_BOOST_ACTIVE=0; FAST_BOOST_RECORDING=0
    fi
    # 恢复原始状态
    [ "$CUR_STATE" != "$ORIG_STATE" ] && set_cdev_state "$ORIG_STATE" && CUR_STATE=$ORIG_STATE
    NCS=$(get_soc); is_num "$NCS" || NCS=0
    NCT=$(get_temp); is_num "$NCT" || NCT=0
    NPW=$(get_power_dw); is_num "$NPW" || NPW=0
    write_status false "$(get_mode)" "$NCS" "$NCT" 0 0 0 "$CUR_STATE" "$MAXSTATE" "$NPW"
    record_history 0 "$NCS" "$NCT" "$CUR_STATE" "$MAXSTATE" "$(get_mode)" "$NPW"
    sleep 8
    continue
  fi
  NOT_CHARGING_STREAK=0

  # 读取当前状态
  SOC=$(get_soc); TEMP=$(get_temp); MODE=$(get_mode)
  if ! is_num "$SOC" || ! is_num "$TEMP"; then sleep 4; continue; fi

  LOOP_COUNT=$((LOOP_COUNT+1))

  # 硬保护：48.5°C 立即满限流
  [ "$TEMP" -ge "$CRIT_TEMP" ] && RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE

  # ============================================================
  # 均衡模式 (46°C)
  # ============================================================
  if [ "$MODE" = "balance" ]; then
    case "$BAL_PROBE_PHASE" in
      "init")
        if [ "$BAL_LEARNED_STATE" -gt 0 ]; then
          BAL_PROBE_STATE=$BAL_LEARNED_STATE; BAL_PROBE_PHASE="stabilizing"
          mylog "BAL INIT: 有学习数据 state=$BAL_LEARNED_STATE"
        else
          BAL_PROBE_STATE=0; BAL_PROBE_PHASE="probing"
          mylog "BAL INIT: 无学习数据, 从 state=0 开始探测"
        fi
        RAW_TARGET=$BAL_PROBE_STATE
        ;;

      "probing")
        if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$BAL_TEMP_TARGET" ]; then
          # 撞墙：更新保守档位，进入冷却
          BAL_HIT_COUNT=$((BAL_HIT_COUNT + 1))
          HIT_STATE=$BAL_PROBE_STATE
          SAFE_CANDIDATE=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
          [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && SAFE_CANDIDATE=$MAXSTATE
          [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$BAL_SAFE_STATE" ] && BAL_SAFE_STATE=$SAFE_CANDIDATE
          BAL_PROBE_PHASE="cooling"
          RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE; BAL_STABLE_SECS=0; BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
          mylog "BAL HIT #$BAL_HIT_COUNT: TEMP=$TEMP >= $BAL_TEMP_TARGET, state=$HIT_STATE 撞墙, 保守档位=$BAL_SAFE_STATE"
        else
          # 没撞墙：检测稳定 / 温度裕度
          if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$BAL_TEMP_SAFE" ] && [ "$TEMP" -lt "$BAL_TEMP_TARGET" ]; then
            # 温度在安全范围，累计稳定时间
            BAL_STABLE_SECS=$((BAL_STABLE_SECS + 2))
            BAL_SESSION_SESSED=1
            BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
            if [ "$BAL_STABLE_SECS" -gt "$BAL_BEST_SECS" ]; then
              BAL_BEST_SECS=$BAL_STABLE_SECS; BAL_BEST_STATE=$BAL_PROBE_STATE
              PW=$(get_power_dw); is_num "$PW" || PW=0; BAL_BEST_POWER=$PW
              mylog "BAL NEW BEST: state=$BAL_PROBE_STATE power=${PW}dw dur=${BAL_STABLE_SECS}s"
            fi
            [ "$BAL_STABLE_SECS" -ge "$STABLE_THRESHOLD" ] && BAL_PROBE_PHASE="stabilizing" && mylog "BAL STABLE: state=$BAL_PROBE_STATE"

          elif [ "$TEMP" -lt $((BAL_TEMP_TARGET - MARGIN_THRESHOLD)) ]; then
            # 温度裕度足够，尝试提高功率
            BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=$((BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS + 2))
            BAL_STABLE_SECS=0
            if [ "$BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS" -ge "$MARGIN_STABLE_SECS" ]; then
              NEW_STATE=$((BAL_PROBE_STATE - 2)); [ "$NEW_STATE" -lt 0 ] && NEW_STATE=0
              [ "$NEW_STATE" -lt "$BAL_PROBE_STATE" ] && BAL_PROBE_STATE=$NEW_STATE && RAW_TARGET=$BAL_PROBE_STATE && BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0 && mylog "BAL MARGIN: 提高到 state=$BAL_PROBE_STATE"
            fi
          else
            BAL_STABLE_SECS=0; BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
          fi
          RAW_TARGET=$BAL_PROBE_STATE
        fi
        ;;

      "cooling")
        # 冷却：等待温度回落，降低功率继续探测
        if [ "$TEMP" -le "$BAL_TEMP_SAFE" ]; then
          # 关键：HIT_STATE + 2 = 增加state = 降低功率
          PROBE_FROM=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
          [ "$PROBE_FROM" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && PROBE_FROM=$MAXSTATE
          [ "$BAL_SAFE_STATE" -gt "$PROBE_FROM" ] && PROBE_FROM=$BAL_SAFE_STATE
          BAL_PROBE_STATE=$PROBE_FROM; BAL_PROBE_PHASE="probing"
          BAL_STABLE_SECS=0; BAL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
          RAW_TARGET=$BAL_PROBE_STATE
          mylog "BAL COOL DONE: 降低功率到 state=$BAL_PROBE_STATE 继续探测"
        else
          RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE
        fi
        ;;

      "stabilizing")
        # 稳定：维持最优档位，撞墙则重新探测
        RAW_TARGET=$BAL_PROBE_STATE
        if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$BAL_TEMP_TARGET" ]; then
          BAL_PROBE_PHASE="cooling"; RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE
          BAL_HIT_COUNT=$((BAL_HIT_COUNT + 1)); HIT_STATE=$BAL_PROBE_STATE; FAST_SESSED=1
          SAFE_CANDIDATE=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
          [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && SAFE_CANDIDATE=$MAXSTATE
          [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$BAL_SAFE_STATE" ] && BAL_SAFE_STATE=$SAFE_CANDIDATE
          mylog "BAL RE-HIT: state=$HIT_STATE 撞墙, 保守档位=$BAL_SAFE_STATE"
        fi
        ;;
    esac

  # ============================================================
  # 冷却模式 (42°C)
  # ============================================================
  elif [ "$MODE" = "cool" ]; then
    case "$COOL_PROBE_PHASE" in
      "init")
        if [ "$COOL_LEARNED_STATE" -gt 0 ]; then
          COOL_PROBE_STATE=$COOL_LEARNED_STATE; COOL_PROBE_PHASE="stabilizing"
          mylog "COOL INIT: 有学习数据 state=$COOL_LEARNED_STATE"
        else
          COOL_PROBE_STATE=0; COOL_PROBE_PHASE="probing"
          mylog "COOL INIT: 无学习数据, 从 state=0 开始探测"
        fi
        RAW_TARGET=$COOL_PROBE_STATE
        ;;

      "probing")
        if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$COOL_TEMP_TARGET" ]; then
          # 撞墙：更新保守档位，进入冷却
          COOL_HIT_COUNT=$((COOL_HIT_COUNT + 1)); HIT_STATE=$COOL_PROBE_STATE
          SAFE_CANDIDATE=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
          [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && SAFE_CANDIDATE=$MAXSTATE
          [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$COOL_SAFE_STATE" ] && COOL_SAFE_STATE=$SAFE_CANDIDATE
          COOL_PROBE_PHASE="cooling"; RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE; COOL_STABLE_SECS=0; COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
          mylog "COOL HIT #$COOL_HIT_COUNT: TEMP=$TEMP >= $COOL_TEMP_TARGET, state=$HIT_STATE 撞墙, 保守档位=$COOL_SAFE_STATE"
        else
          if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$COOL_TEMP_SAFE" ] && [ "$TEMP" -lt "$COOL_TEMP_TARGET" ]; then
            # 温度在安全范围，累计稳定时间
            COOL_STABLE_SECS=$((COOL_STABLE_SECS + 2)); COOL_SESSION_SESSED=1; COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
            if [ "$COOL_STABLE_SECS" -gt "$COOL_BEST_SECS" ]; then
              COOL_BEST_SECS=$COOL_STABLE_SECS; COOL_BEST_STATE=$COOL_PROBE_STATE
              PW=$(get_power_dw); is_num "$PW" || PW=0; COOL_BEST_POWER=$PW
              mylog "COOL NEW BEST: state=$COOL_PROBE_STATE power=${PW}dw dur=${COOL_STABLE_SECS}s"
            fi
            [ "$COOL_STABLE_SECS" -ge "$STABLE_THRESHOLD" ] && COOL_PROBE_PHASE="stabilizing" && mylog "COOL STABLE: state=$COOL_PROBE_STATE"

          elif [ "$TEMP" -lt $((COOL_TEMP_TARGET - MARGIN_THRESHOLD)) ]; then
            # 温度裕度足够，尝试提高功率
            COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=$((COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS + 2)); COOL_STABLE_SECS=0
            if [ "$COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS" -ge "$MARGIN_STABLE_SECS" ]; then
              NEW_STATE=$((COOL_PROBE_STATE - 2)); [ "$NEW_STATE" -lt 0 ] && NEW_STATE=0
              [ "$NEW_STATE" -lt "$COOL_PROBE_STATE" ] && COOL_PROBE_STATE=$NEW_STATE && RAW_TARGET=$COOL_PROBE_STATE && COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0 && mylog "COOL MARGIN: 提高到 state=$COOL_PROBE_STATE"
            fi
          else
            COOL_STABLE_SECS=0; COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
          fi
          RAW_TARGET=$COOL_PROBE_STATE
        fi
        ;;

      "cooling")
        # 冷却：等待温度回落，降低功率继续探测
        if [ "$TEMP" -le "$COOL_TEMP_SAFE" ]; then
          # 关键：HIT_STATE + 2 = 增加state = 降低功率
          PROBE_FROM=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
          [ "$PROBE_FROM" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && PROBE_FROM=$MAXSTATE
          [ "$COOL_SAFE_STATE" -gt "$PROBE_FROM" ] && PROBE_FROM=$COOL_SAFE_STATE
          COOL_PROBE_STATE=$PROBE_FROM; COOL_PROBE_PHASE="probing"
          COOL_STABLE_SECS=0; COOL_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
          RAW_TARGET=$COOL_PROBE_STATE
          mylog "COOL COOL DONE: 降低功率到 state=$COOL_PROBE_STATE 继续探测"
        else
          RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE
        fi
        ;;

      "stabilizing")
        # 稳定：维持最优档位，撞墙则重新探测
        RAW_TARGET=$COOL_PROBE_STATE
        if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$COOL_TEMP_TARGET" ]; then
          COOL_PROBE_PHASE="cooling"; RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE
          COOL_HIT_COUNT=$((COOL_HIT_COUNT + 1)); HIT_STATE=$COOL_PROBE_STATE; COOL_SESSION_SESSED=1
          SAFE_CANDIDATE=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
          [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && SAFE_CANDIDATE=$MAXSTATE
          [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$COOL_SAFE_STATE" ] && COOL_SAFE_STATE=$SAFE_CANDIDATE
          mylog "COOL RE-HIT: state=$HIT_STATE 撞墙, 保守档位=$COOL_SAFE_STATE"
        fi
        ;;
    esac

  # ============================================================
  # 快充模式 (48°C) / 快充+散热器模式 (48°C)
  # ============================================================
  elif [ "$MODE" = "fast" ] || [ "$MODE" = "fast_cooler" ]; then
    # 子模式切换检测
    if [ "$MODE" != "$LAST_FAST_SUBMODE" ]; then
      [ "$MODE" = "fast_cooler" ] && CUR_FAST_LEARN_FILE="$FAST_COOLER_LEARN_FILE" || CUR_FAST_LEARN_FILE="$FAST_LEARN_FILE"
      load_learn "$CUR_FAST_LEARN_FILE"
      FAST_LEARNED_STATE=$LEARNED_STATE
      FAST_LEARNED_POWER=$LEARNED_POWER_DW
      FAST_LEARNED_DUR=$LEARNED_DUR
      FAST_LEARNED_SESSIONS=$SESSION_COUNT
      FAST_LEARNED_MAXPW=$LEARNED_MAX_POWER_DW
      FAST_PROBE_STATE=$LEARNED_STATE
      FAST_BEST_SECS=$LEARNED_DUR
      FAST_BEST_POWER=$LEARNED_POWER_DW
      FAST_BEST_STATE=$LEARNED_STATE
      FAST_MAX_POWER_DW=$LEARNED_MAX_POWER_DW
      FAST_PROBE_PHASE="init"
      FAST_HIT_COUNT=0
      FAST_STABLE_SECS=0
      FAST_SESSION_SESSED=0
      FAST_SESSED=0
      FAST_BOOST_ACTIVE=0
      FAST_BOOST_RECORDING=0
      LAST_FAST_SUBMODE=$MODE
      mylog "FAST SUBMODE SWITCH: mode=$MODE loaded from $CUR_FAST_LEARN_FILE state=$LEARNED_STATE"
    fi

    # 急速补电：SOC<10%激活，<20%全速，>=20%切换到探测
    if [ "$FAST_BOOST_RECORDING" = "0" ] && [ "$FAST_BOOST_ACTIVE" = "0" ] && [ "$SOC" -lt 10 ]; then
      FAST_BOOST_ACTIVE=1; FAST_BOOST_RECORDING=1; FAST_MAX_POWER_DW=0
      mylog "FAST BOOST START: SOC=$SOC, recording max power"
    fi
    if [ "$FAST_BOOST_ACTIVE" = "1" ]; then
      if [ "$SOC" -lt 20 ]; then
        RAW_TARGET=0
        PW=$(get_power_dw); is_num "$PW" || PW=0
        [ "$PW" -gt "$FAST_MAX_POWER_DW" ] && FAST_MAX_POWER_DW=$PW
      else
        FAST_BOOST_ACTIVE=0; FAST_BOOST_RECORDING=0; FAST_PROBE_PHASE="init"
        mylog "FAST BOOST END: SOC=$SOC max_power=${FAST_MAX_POWER_DW}dw"
      fi
    fi

    # 撞墙探测
    if [ "$FAST_BOOST_ACTIVE" = "0" ]; then
      case "$FAST_PROBE_PHASE" in
        "init")
          if [ "$FAST_LEARNED_STATE" -gt 0 ]; then
            FAST_PROBE_STATE=$FAST_LEARNED_STATE; FAST_PROBE_PHASE="stabilizing"
            mylog "FAST INIT: 有学习数据 state=$FAST_LEARNED_STATE"
          else
            FAST_PROBE_STATE=0; FAST_PROBE_PHASE="probing"
            mylog "FAST INIT: 无学习数据, 从 state=0 开始探测"
          fi
          RAW_TARGET=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
          ;;

        "probing")
          if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$FAST_TEMP_RED" ]; then
            # 撞墙了！记录当前撞墙的state
            FAST_HIT_COUNT=$((FAST_HIT_COUNT + 1))
            HIT_STATE=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
            FAST_SESSED=1

            # 撞墙：更新保守档位，进入冷却
            SAFE_CANDIDATE=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
            [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && SAFE_CANDIDATE=$MAXSTATE
            [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$FAST_SAFE_STATE" ] && FAST_SAFE_STATE=$SAFE_CANDIDATE
            FAST_PROBE_PHASE="cooling"; RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE; FAST_STABLE_SECS=0; FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
            mylog "FAST HIT #$FAST_HIT_COUNT: TEMP=$TEMP >= $FAST_TEMP_RED, state=$HIT_STATE 撞墙, 保守档位=$FAST_SAFE_STATE"
          else
            if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$FAST_TEMP_SAFE" ] && [ "$TEMP" -lt "$FAST_TEMP_RED" ]; then
              # 温度在安全范围，累计稳定时间
              FAST_STABLE_SECS=$((FAST_STABLE_SECS + 2)); FAST_SESSION_SESSED=1; FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
              if [ "$FAST_STABLE_SECS" -gt "$FAST_BEST_SECS" ]; then
                FAST_BEST_SECS=$FAST_STABLE_SECS; FAST_BEST_STATE=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
                PW=$(get_power_dw); is_num "$PW" || PW=0; FAST_BEST_POWER=$PW
                mylog "FAST NEW BEST: state=$FAST_PROBE_STATE power=${PW}dw dur=${FAST_STABLE_SECS}s"
              fi
              [ "$FAST_STABLE_SECS" -ge "$STABLE_THRESHOLD" ] && FAST_PROBE_PHASE="stabilizing" && mylog "FAST STABLE: state=$FAST_PROBE_STATE"

            elif [ "$TEMP" -lt $((FAST_TEMP_RED - MARGIN_THRESHOLD)) ]; then
              # 温度裕度足够，尝试提高功率
              FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=$((FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS + 2)); FAST_STABLE_SECS=0
              if [ "$FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS" -ge "$MARGIN_STABLE_SECS" ]; then
                NEW_STATE=$((FAST_PROBE_STATE - 2)); [ "$NEW_STATE" -lt 0 ] && NEW_STATE=0
                [ "$NEW_STATE" -lt "$FAST_PROBE_STATE" ] && FAST_PROBE_STATE=$NEW_STATE && RAW_TARGET=$FAST_PROBE_STATE && FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0 && mylog "FAST MARGIN: 提高到 state=$FAST_PROBE_STATE"
              fi
            else
              FAST_STABLE_SECS=0; FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
            fi
            RAW_TARGET=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
          fi
          ;;

        "cooling")
          # 冷却：等待温度回落，降低功率继续探测
          if [ "$TEMP" -le "$FAST_TEMP_SAFE" ]; then
            # 关键：HIT_STATE + 2 = 增加state = 降低功率
            PROBE_FROM=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
            [ "$PROBE_FROM" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && PROBE_FROM=$MAXSTATE
            [ "$FAST_SAFE_STATE" -gt "$PROBE_FROM" ] && PROBE_FROM=$FAST_SAFE_STATE

            FAST_PROBE_STATE=$PROBE_FROM
            FAST_PROBE_PHASE="probing"; FAST_STABLE_SECS=0; FAST_MARGIN_STABLE_SECS=0
            RAW_TARGET=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
            mylog "FAST COOL DONE: 降低功率到 state=$FAST_PROBE_STATE 继续探测"
          else
            RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE
          fi
          ;;

        "stabilizing")
          # 稳定：维持最优档位，撞墙则重新探测
          RAW_TARGET=$FAST_PROBE_STATE
          if [ "$TEMP" -ge "$FAST_TEMP_RED" ]; then
            FAST_PROBE_PHASE="cooling"; RAW_TARGET=$MAXSTATE
            FAST_HIT_COUNT=$((FAST_HIT_COUNT + 1)); HIT_STATE=$FAST_PROBE_STATE; FAST_SESSED=1
            SAFE_CANDIDATE=$((HIT_STATE + 2))
            [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$MAXSTATE" ] && SAFE_CANDIDATE=$MAXSTATE
            [ "$SAFE_CANDIDATE" -gt "$FAST_SAFE_STATE" ] && FAST_SAFE_STATE=$SAFE_CANDIDATE
            mylog "FAST RE-HIT: state=$HIT_STATE 撞墙, 保守档位=$FAST_SAFE_STATE"
          fi
          ;;
      esac
    fi

  else
    RAW_TARGET=0
  fi

  RAW_TARGET=$(clamp "$RAW_TARGET" 0 "$MAXSTATE")

  # 高电量taper：作为下限(floor)，带5%滞回
  NEW_SOC_FLOOR=$CUR_SOC_FLOOR
  [ "$SOC" -ge 96 ] && [ "$CUR_SOC_FLOOR" -lt $(( (MAXSTATE * 2 + 5) / 10 )) ] && NEW_SOC_FLOOR=$(( (MAXSTATE * 2 + 5) / 10 ))
  [ "$SOC" -ge 88 ] && [ "$CUR_SOC_FLOOR" -lt $(( (MAXSTATE * 1 + 5) / 10 )) ] && NEW_SOC_FLOOR=$(( (MAXSTATE * 1 + 5) / 10 ))
  [ "$SOC" -lt 91 ] && [ "$CUR_SOC_FLOOR" -ge $(( (MAXSTATE * 2 + 5) / 10 )) ] && NEW_SOC_FLOOR=$(( (MAXSTATE * 1 + 5) / 10 ))
  [ "$SOC" -lt 83 ] && [ "$CUR_SOC_FLOOR" -ge $(( (MAXSTATE * 1 + 5) / 10 )) ] && NEW_SOC_FLOOR=0
  CUR_SOC_FLOOR=$NEW_SOC_FLOOR; SOC_FLOOR=$CUR_SOC_FLOOR

  # 模式特定的下限
  MODE_FLOOR=0
  case $MODE in
    fast)   SOC_FLOOR=0; [ "$SOC" -ge 97 ] && SOC_FLOOR=$(( (MAXSTATE * 1 + 5) / 10 )) ;;
    cool)   MODE_FLOOR=$(( (MAXSTATE * 1 + 5) / 10 )); [ "$SOC_FLOOR" -lt "$MODE_FLOOR" ] && SOC_FLOOR=$MODE_FLOOR ;;
  esac

  # 最终状态 = max(探测目标, 电量下限, 模式下限)
  TARGET_STATE=$RAW_TARGET
  [ "$SOC_FLOOR" -gt "$TARGET_STATE" ] && TARGET_STATE=$SOC_FLOOR
  [ "$MODE_FLOOR" -gt "$TARGET_STATE" ] && TARGET_STATE=$MODE_FLOOR
  TARGET_STATE=$(clamp "$TARGET_STATE" 0 "$MAXSTATE")

  [ "$TARGET_STATE" != "$CUR_STATE" ] && set_cdev_state "$TARGET_STATE" && CUR_STATE=$TARGET_STATE

  # 记录状态
  case "$MODE" in
    balance)       mylog "BAL SOC=$SOC TEMP=$TEMP phase=$BAL_PROBE_PHASE hits=$BAL_HIT_COUNT best=$BAL_BEST_STATE STATE=$CUR_STATE/$MAXSTATE" ;;
    cool)          mylog "COOL SOC=$SOC TEMP=$TEMP phase=$COOL_PROBE_PHASE hits=$COOL_HIT_COUNT best=$COOL_BEST_STATE STATE=$CUR_STATE/$MAXSTATE" ;;
    fast|fast_cooler) mylog "FAST SOC=$SOC TEMP=$TEMP phase=$FAST_PROBE_PHASE hits=$FAST_HIT_COUNT boost=$FAST_BOOST_ACTIVE best=$FAST_BEST_STATE STATE=$CUR_STATE/$MAXSTATE" ;;
    *)             mylog "MODE=$MODE SOC=$SOC TEMP=$TEMP STATE=$CUR_STATE/$MAXSTATE" ;;
  esac
  POWER_DW=$(get_power_dw); is_num "$POWER_DW" || POWER_DW=0
  write_status true "$MODE" "$SOC" "$TEMP" "$RAW_TARGET" "$SOC_FLOOR" "$TARGET_STATE" "$CUR_STATE" "$MAXSTATE" "$POWER_DW"
  record_history 1 "$SOC" "$TEMP" "$CUR_STATE" "$MAXSTATE" "$MODE" "$POWER_DW"
  probe_charge_currents
  sleep 2
